recentItems.title: Cyberattacks target FBI and USDA
recentItems.description: President Trump is now confirming an FBI database hack, just hours after sources say the USDA was the target of a cyberattack. ABC News' Steven Portnoy has the latest.

recentItems.title: Flu activity higher than usual this Thanksgiving, CDC says
recentItems.description: Flu activity is higher than usual heading into Thanksgiving, with at least 3.7 million illnesses and 2,800 deaths so far this season, according to the CDC. Experts say getting a flu shot, washing your hands and staying home if you’re sick can help keep the holiday germ-free.

recentItems.title: Mayor mamdani joins Javits Frimpong’s parents in honoring the teen at his funeral
recentItems.description: Community members came together Friday to honor the life of 15-year-old Javits Frimpong, who authorities say was shot in the stomach last month on his way to school. Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Rev. Al Sharpton were among the leaders who attended the funeral to honor the teen and support his family.
